import * as THREE from 'three';
/** Exact union of a complete source-cell rectangular thin layer. Source
 * Float32 bottom heights are retained, including their microscopic steps. */
export function buildDuixiuBaseUnion(cells,cut){
 const xs=[...new Set(cells.flatMap(c=>[c.x0,c.x1]))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),zs=[...new Set(cells.flatMap(c=>[c.z0,c.z1]))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),grid=new Map();for(const c of cells){const i=xs.indexOf(c.x0),j=zs.indexOf(c.z0);if(xs[i+1]!==c.x1||zs[j+1]!==c.z1||!(cut>c.bottom))throw Error('Invalid source base cell');grid.set(`${i},${j}`,c);}if(grid.size!==(xs.length-1)*(zs.length-1))throw Error('Incomplete source base rectangle');
 const at=(i,j)=>grid.get(`${i},${j}`),point=(i,j,y)=>new THREE.Vector3(xs[i],y,zs[j]),levels=(i,j,low,high)=>[...new Set([low,high,...[at(i-1,j-1),at(i,j-1),at(i-1,j),at(i,j)].filter(Boolean).map(c=>c.bottom)].filter(y=>y>=low&&y<=high))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),pos=[],normal=[],uv=[],color=[];
 const tri=(a,b,c,want)=>{let n=b.clone().sub(a).cross(c.clone().sub(a));if(n.lengthSq()===0)return;if(n.dot(want)<0){[b,c]=[c,b];n.negate();}n.normalize();for(const p of[a,b,c]){pos.push(...p.toArray());normal.push(...n.toArray());const ax=Math.abs(n.x),ay=Math.abs(n.y),az=Math.abs(n.z);uv.push(...(ay>=ax&&ay>=az?[p.x/3,p.z/3]:ax>=az?[p.z/3,p.y/3]:[p.x/3,p.y/3]));color.push(.69,.67965,.6486);}};
 const wall=(a,b,low,high,want)=>{if(high<=low)return;const aa=levels(...a,low,high).map(y=>point(...a,y)),bb=levels(...b,low,high).map(y=>point(...b,y));let i=0,j=0;while(i<aa.length-1||j<bb.length-1){if(j===bb.length-1||(i<aa.length-1&&aa[i+1].y<=bb[j+1].y)){tri(aa[i],bb[j],aa[i+1],want);i++;}else{tri(aa[i],bb[j],bb[j+1],want);j++;}}};
 for(let j=0;j<zs.length-1;j++)for(let i=0;i<xs.length-1;i++){const c=at(i,j);for(const[y,normalY]of[[cut,1],[c.bottom,-1]]){const a=point(i,j,y),b=point(i+1,j,y),cc=point(i+1,j+1,y),d=point(i,j+1,y),n=new THREE.Vector3(0,normalY,0);tri(a,b,cc,n);tri(a,cc,d,n);}wall([i,j],[i,j+1],c.bottom,at(i-1,j)?.bottom??cut,new THREE.Vector3(-1,0,0));wall([i+1,j],[i+1,j+1],c.bottom,at(i+1,j)?.bottom??cut,new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0));wall([i,j],[i+1,j],c.bottom,at(i,j-1)?.bottom??cut,new THREE.Vector3(0,0,-1));wall([i,j+1],[i+1,j+1],c.bottom,at(i,j+1)?.bottom??cut,new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1));}
 const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();for(const[name,values]of[['position',pos],['normal',normal],['uv',uv],['color',color]])g.setAttribute(name,new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(values,name==='uv'?2:3));return g;
}
